item.title: World Athletics To Introduce New Distances To Race Walk Events In 2026
item.description: World Athletics will introduce half-marathon and marathon distances to race walk events in 2026 in an effort to help fans better grasp the speed of the sport, president Sebastian Coe has said.

item.title: SA Have Been A Bit Hot And Cold In The T20I Series: Robin Uthappa
item.description: Robin Uthappa: As the fourth T20I of the five-match series between India and South Africa was called off without a ball being bowled due to excessive fog in Lucknow, pushing the series outcome to the final match, former India batter Robin Uthappa shared his thoughts on the series so far, saying that the visitors have been ‘a bit hot and cold’ in the T20Is.

item.title: GCL Season 3: Alpine SG Pipers Beat American Gambits To Jump To Second Spot; Leaders Mumba Masters Defeat Alaskan Knights
item.description: World Rapid Champion Volodar Murzin: Alpine SG Pipers stormed their way into title contention by registering their second consecutive win, thanks to yet another clinical performance on the prodigy board by GM Leon Luke Mendonca and a last-gasp victory by Player of the Match Nino Batsiashvili on Matchday 4 of the Global Chess League (GCL) on Wednesday.

item.title: India Have Been The Better Team In T20Is: Dale Steyn
item.description: Narendra Modi Stadium: The ongoing India-South Africa series remains fiercely contested, with two possible outcomes before the final game: South Africa drawing level at 2-2 or India winning it 3-1, and former Proteas fast bowler Dale Steyn opined that India have ‘been the better team’ so far in the three games played.

item.title: CIDCO Open 2025: Veer Ahlawat Fires A Second Straight 65 To Build A Three-shot Lead In Round Two
item.description: Kharghar Valley Golf Course: Veer Ahlawat fired a second straight six-under 65 to build a three-shot lead in the second round of the INR 1 crore CIDCO Open 2025, the first-ever professional event being played at the Kharghar Valley Golf Course (KVGC) in Navi Mumbai.

item.title: Conway, Latham Smash 323-Run Opening Stand in 3rd Test vs West Indies
item.description: New Zealand dominated day one of the third Test against West Indies as Devon Conway and Tom Latham shared a massive 323-run opening partnership, powering the hosts to 334/1 at Mount Maunganui.

item.title: Football: Brazilian Defender Cleiton Joins Wolfsburg
item.description: FC Bayern Munich: Bundesliga club VfL Wolfsburg announced on Wednesday that it has signed Brazilian defender Cleiton Santana dos Santos from Flamengo, with the transfer to take effect on January 1, 2026. Cleiton has agreed to a deal through June 30, 2030.

item.title: ‘Worst Technology': Starc Calls For Snicko To Be 'sacked’ After Controversial Umpiring In Adelaide Test
item.description: Skipper Ben Stokes: Controversial umpiring at the Ashes persisted even on Day 2 of the ongoing third Test here at the Adelaide Oval as Australian pacer Mitchell Starc expressed his frustration and opined that the snicko technology ‘needs to be sacked’.

item.title: Real And Atletico Madrid Claim Narrow Wins In Copa Del Rey
item.description: Gonzalo Di Renzo: Real Madrid edged into the fourth round of the Copa del Rey after a nervous 3-2 win away to third-tier Talavera.

item.title: Pakistan Name Farhan Yousaf-led Squad For U19 World Cup
item.description: ICC U19 World Cup: Farhan Yousaf will continue to captain Pakistan U19 as the 15-member squad, as the Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB) has been named for the upcoming tri-series in Zimbabwe and the ICC U19 World Cup.
